heldout_exact_covered_note: held-out states are disjoint from the 1200 table states by construction, so exact-level coverage is 0 unless the split leaks; a 0 here is not evidence about table quality
agreement_exact_reason: no held-out state reached the exact lookup level (coverage 0), so this ratio has no denominator; `agreement_lookup` is the only rate here that is defined
lookup_note: agreement_lookup compares a live LLM call on 200 DISJOINT held-out states against the two-level lookup (exact -> coarse -> role) that the simulator uses
unparseable_note: states where all 3 samples failed to parse an action; the row is held at 'stay' so the simulator has an entry, and each such row is marked source=filler. The stay share in policy_action_distribution mixes real and filler stays unless this count is subtracted.
faithful_rule: point estimate >= threshold AND Wilson 95% lower bound >= threshold; `faithful_point_only` is the point-estimate reading and is NOT the gate
faithful_reason: point estimate 0.740 >= 0.7 but the 95% interval [0.675, 0.796] crosses the threshold: not established at n=200. H2 fidelity is reported as UNRESOLVED, not as NON_FAITHFUL -- the data cannot separate the two.
